# kitsplit

Stereo (or mono) drum-bus recording → per-drum stems
(`kick, snare, toms, hh, ride, crash, residual`, plus 6/5/4-stem groupings) that sum
back to the input within 1e-6.

## Status (read this first)

<!-- claims:begin (generated by scripts/update_readme_claims.py; do not edit) -->
**No quality claims.** No benchmark on the held-out real drum-bus set (`data/eval_real`, plan §4.3) exists yet, and `kitsplit-v1` has not been trained.
<!-- claims:end -->

What exists: the full inference pipeline (I/O, chunking, shift-TTA, mixture
consistency, torch + ONNX backends), a sha256-pinned model registry with the two public
baselines (B1, B2; **eval-only**, see `docs/LICENSES.md`), StemGMD → MSST Type 1
conversion with GMD folds and onsets, drum-bus augmentation, the MSST training adapter,
metrics and the benchmark runner. What does not exist: a trained `kitsplit-v1` model
(no GPU and no full StemGMD in the development container), the held-out real eval set,
the desktop app. Separation-quality numbers for B1/B2 on a StemGMD subset are in
`reports/` as a development reference only.

## Install

```bash
git submodule update --init third_party/Music-Source-Separation-Training
pip install torch torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu   # or a CUDA build
pip install -e ".[dev,onnx,msst,data,train,baselines]"
kitsplit doctor
```

## Use

```bash
kitsplit models list                          # names, kinds, licenses
kitsplit models fetch B1                      # sha256-verified download (eval-only weights)
kitsplit separate drums.wav --out stems/ --model B1 --stems 7
kitsplit info drums.wav
kitsplit dataset build-stemgmd --src StemGMD --gmd groove-v1.0.0-midionly.zip --out data/stemgmd
kitsplit augment --in data/stemgmd/train --out data/augmented_cache --config configs/augment/drumbus_v1.yaml
kitsplit train --model-config configs/model/mdx23c_7stem.yaml --data data/stemgmd/train data/augmented_cache \
               --valid data/stemgmd/validation --results reports/train/run1 --gpus 0
kitsplit benchmark --data data/eval_real --models kitsplit-v1,B1,B2 --out reports/
```

Exit codes: 0 ok, 2 bad input/args, 3 model missing/corrupt, 4 device unavailable,
5 output exists (use `--overwrite`), 6 license gate, 10 internal error.
`--json` output is versioned (`kitsplit.separate.v1`).

## Tests

```bash
pytest -m "not quality"                       # CI, CPU only (~2 min)
KITSPLIT_NETWORK_TESTS=1 pytest -m network    # downloads B1/B2 and runs them
pytest -m quality --real-data data/eval_real  # GPU box, needs the real eval set
```
Tests marked `plumbing` use oracle / random-weights models: they prove the pipeline,
not separation quality.

Docs: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/EVAL_PROTOCOL.md`, `docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md`
(assumptions + deliberate deviations from the plan), `docs/LICENSES.md`.
